title: 第101章 文道风骨浩然长存第100章 星汉灿烂若出其里
slug: 我被系统坑成了造物主
content_zh:
颁奖之时，姬云天亲自将那支准备好的千秋文心笔金笔颁给文强，握着他的手轻声道：“文道兴衰，不在天道，不在先贤，在于你我，在于每一个愿意提笔的后来人。今日你站在这里，来日就要把这传承接过去，传下去。”文强紧紧握着笔杆，对着姬云天深深叩首，声音哽咽道：“弟子记下了，文道要兴，传承要续，弟子生生世世，不敢忘。”
接着是孙立君和武常顺，分别得到了千秋文心笔很笔和铜笔，不是什么特别的法器，更多的是对他们在此次比赛的肯定，姬云天也是一番淳淳教诲，二人也是非常积极，立下豪言壮语。但姬云天心里有点麻，莫名其妙的。
台下众人看着这一幕，不少文道修士已经红了眼眶，这么多年文道式微，他们守得辛苦，却从没有像今天这样觉得，文道还有希望，传承还有未来。
姬云天转过身，对着全场高声道：“今天这大赛不是结束，而是开始，往后每三年，轩辕学院都会开一次文道盛会，不管你是出身大宗还是散修，只要你走文道，就来轩辕，我们给你留着位置，给你搭着台子，只要传承不断，文道就一定会兴！，文道风骨，浩然长存！”
话音落下，全场爆发出雷鸣般的掌声，经久不息，淡淡的文气从无数人胸中升腾而起，聚在轩辕学院的上空，凝出了一片淡淡的青云，连阳光落在上面，都染上了温润的光泽。
看着下面灼灼的目光，姬云天接着道：“文道之修行，首先修的是浩然正气，此为基，所谓天地有正气，杂然赋流形。守正道，盈正气，是我辈修行之路的初心，不可忘记。”
下方一众修士齐声附和。
姬云天又道：“我以为。修行之路有三个阶段或者说是三个境界。三个境界分别是“立”“守”“得”，对应文道修行的的三个阶段：确立目标、坚持探索、顿悟成功。”下方一众安静聆听。
姬云天道：“第一境界：立，就是明确方向。此阶段我赠各位一句：昨夜西风凋碧树，独上高楼，望尽天涯路。这一境界是修士在文道修行的迷茫期。处于此境的修士已心有所系，但面对广阔的学问或文道之路，感到无从下手，前路茫然。虽然经历了孤独、困惑，但同时也确立了追求的目标和方向，是修行的基础阶段
。”听到姬云天的话，众人也开始沉思起来。
姬云天又道：“第二境界：守，即是锲而不舍。此阶段我赠各位一句：衣带渐宽终不悔，为伊消得人憔悴
此境界体现奋斗与坚持。我辈修士，养浩然正气，追求无尽大道，应当全力以赴，心无旁骛，即使经历艰辛、身心憔悴，也不后悔。这是一个过程，是从迷茫到成就的关键阶段，通过不断努力积累感悟与天地之力。”
话音一落，下方众人皆是满眼的崇拜之光。
姬云天接着道：“第三境界：得乃是顿悟成功。我赠各位一句：众里寻他千百度，蓦然回首，那人却在灯火阑珊处。这一境界象征顿悟与收获。经过长期探索和积累，最终在不经意间获得突破或真知，体现量变到质变的转化。以不争之心而争圆满，以不求之心而得天下，到了这个境界是豁然开朗，得之坦然，失之淡然。”话音落下，下方瞬间安静。
有几位修士已经当即坐下，进入了顿悟的状态。看到这种情形，姬云天打了个一个噤声的手势，随后，剑漫天将几人用结界包裹，送到了之前顿悟之人所在的山上。
随后，姬飞雪大声宣布：“本次比赛获得圆满成功。所有参与此次轩辕学院决赛的修士，此次破例全部录用，按照名次分级提供相应的资源！”
姬飞雪的话音落下，引发下方全员轰动，本来想着已经被淘汰出局，没有想到还有这等机会，让那些参与此次大赛而未获得前三的修士们欣喜若狂，其中有些老者更是涕泗横流，跪伏感谢。
文道修士本就不是主流，而且很难达成仙境，就像这次比赛，除了很少的武修兼修文道以外，修为达到了仙境，纯文道修士都在渡劫境以下。
那些苍髯老者，有的已经绝了希望，这次能够拼到前百名，可以说是用尽了毕生的心血，却没有进入前十，他们的前路已经断了，现在听到姬飞雪的承诺，无不激动得不能自已。
武道灵气的修炼与文道的浩然正气的修炼有着本质的不同。武道修行多借天地灵气淬炼自身，讲究的是突破桎梏、夺天地造化，进阶神速者年纪轻轻便可登临高位，引得无数修士趋之若鹜。

可文道修行，全凭胸中一口浩然气撑着，要一字一句打磨学识，一点一滴涵养正心，从来没有捷径可走，多少人皓首穷经钻研一生，都未必能摸到仙境的门槛，到了晚年油尽灯枯，只能带着遗憾埋骨山野，连一身所学都未必能传下去。
久而久之，愿意沉下心走文道的人越来越少，文道也渐渐式微，成了世人眼中旁门左道的末流。现在轩辕学院开设了文道院，还举办了诗词大赛，为天下文道修士提供了展示的舞台，现在姬飞雪院长还为文道修士提供了修炼的场所，还提供资源，这让无数文道学者更加发自内心的感激。
今天轩辕学院给了所有文道修士一条生路，给了每一个坚持走到最后的人落脚的地方，给了他们继续修行、传承所学的机会。
看着跪伏在地泪流满面的老者，台上文强攥着手中的千秋文心笔，指节微微泛白，姬云天那句“文道兴衰，在于你我”反反复复在他耳边响着，胸中那团温热的浩然气不停翻涌，几乎要冲破胸膛。
随着此次大赛尘埃落定，一时之间，苍天大世界刮起了一股作诗词论文道的风气，不少原本只埋头修炼武道的修士，也开始试着坐下来读书写字，摸索文道的门路。
content_en:
When awarding the award, Ji Yuntian personally awarded the prepared golden Qianqiu Literary Pen to Wen Qiang. He held his hand and said softly: "The rise and fall of literature does not depend on the way of heaven or the sages, but on you and me, and on everyone who is willing to pick up the pen. Today you Standing here, I will take over this inheritance and pass it on in the future." Wen Qiang held the pen tightly, kowtowed deeply to Ji Yuntian, and said with a choked voice: "Disciple has made a note of it. The culture must be flourished and the inheritance must be continued. Disciples will not forget it for generations to come."
Then came Sun Lijun and Wu Changshun, who received the Qianqiu Wenxin Brush Pen and the Bronze Brush Pen respectively. It was not a special magic weapon, but more of an affirmation of their performance in this competition. Ji Yuntian also gave some Chunchun teachings. The two were also very active and made heroic speeches. But Ji Yuntian felt a little numb, inexplicably.
Everyone in the audience looked at this scene, and many literary monks had red eyes. They had worked hard to guard the decline of civility for so many years, but they had never felt like they did today that there was still hope for civility and that the inheritance still had a future.
Ji Yuntian turned around and said loudly to the audience: "Today's competition is not the end, but the beginning. Every three years from now on, Xuanyuan College will hold a literary event. No matter whether you are from a major sect or a casual cultivator, as long as you follow the literary path, come to Xuanyuan. We will reserve a place for you and set up a stage for you. As long as the inheritance continues, the literary spirit will flourish! The literary spirit will last forever!"
As soon as the words fell, the audience burst into thunderous applause. It lasted for a long time, and a faint literary spirit rose from the hearts of countless people. It gathered in the sky above Xuanyuan College and formed a faint blue cloud. Even the sunlight falling on it was dyed with a warm luster.
Looking at the scorching eyes below, Ji Yuntian continued: "In the practice of literature and art, the first thing to cultivate is the awe-inspiring righteousness, which is the foundation. It is said that the heaven and the earth have righteousness, which is mixed and endowed with manifolds. Keeping the right way and filling the righteousness is the original intention of our generation's cultivation path, and we must not forget it."
All the monks below agreed in unison.
Ji Yuntian added: "I think there are three stages or three realms in the path of spiritual practice. The three realms are "establishing", "keeping" and "getting", which correspond to the three stages of literary practice: establishing goals, persisting in exploration, and enlightenment and success." The crowd below listened quietly.
Ji Yuntian said: "The first state: standing is to have a clear direction. At this stage, I will give you a sentence: last night the west wind withered the green trees, and I climbed up to the tall building alone and looked at the end of the world. This state is the confused period of the monks in the practice of literature and art. The monks in this state have something to do with their hearts, but facing the vast road of learning or literature, they feel unable to start and the way forward is at a loss. Although they have experienced loneliness and confusion, they have also established the goal and direction of pursuit, which is the basic stage of practice.
. "After hearing Ji Yuntian's words, everyone began to think deeply.
Ji Yuntian said again: "The second realm: to guard, that is to persevere. At this stage, I will give you a sentence: the clothes will get wider and wider, and you will never regret it. You will be haggard because of Yi.
This state embodies struggle and persistence. As monks, we, cultivating our righteousness and pursuing the endless path, should go all out and have no distractions. Even if we experience hardships and are exhausted physically and mentally, we will not regret it. This is a process, a critical stage from confusion to achievement. Through continuous efforts, we accumulate insights and the power of heaven and earth. "
As soon as he finished speaking, everyone below was filled with admiration.
Ji Yuntian continued: "The third realm: the achievement is the success of epiphany. Let me give you a sentence: I searched for him thousands of times in the crowd, and suddenly I looked back, and that person was in the dim light. This realm symbolizes epiphany and harvest. After long-term exploration and accumulation, I finally found myself here. Gaining breakthroughs or true knowledge unexpectedly embodies the transformation from quantitative change to qualitative change. Striving for perfection with a non-striving heart, and gaining the world with a non-seeking heart. When you reach this state, you will be enlightened, calm about gain, and calm about loss." After the words fell, there was a moment of silence.
Several monks had already sat down immediately and entered a state of enlightenment. Seeing this situation, Ji YunTian made a silent gesture, and then Jian Mantian wrapped several people in a barrier and sent them to the mountain where the enlightened person was.
Afterwards, Ji Feixue announced loudly: "This competition was a complete success. All the monks who participated in the Xuanyuan Academy finals will be accepted as an exception and corresponding resources will be provided according to their rankings!"
Ji Feixue's words fell, causing a stir among everyone below. They originally thought they had been eliminated, but they didn't expect there would be such an opportunity. The monks who participated in this competition but did not get the top three were ecstatic. Some of the old men even shed tears and knelt down to thank them.
Wen Dao monks are not the mainstream, and it is difficult to reach the Immortal Realm. Just like this competition, except for a few martial arts cultivators who also study Wen Dao, their cultivation has reached the Immortal Realm, and pure Wen Dao monks are all below the Tribulation Realm.
Some of those old men with gray beards have given up hope. To be able to reach the top 100 this time can be said to have been a lifetime effort, but they did not make it to the top ten. Their way forward has been cut off. Now that they heard Ji Feixue's promise, they were all so excited that they couldn't help themselves.
The cultivation of spiritual energy in martial arts is fundamentally different from the cultivation of awe-inspiring righteousness in literary Dao. Martial arts practice often relies on the spiritual energy of heaven and earth to temper oneself. The emphasis is on breaking through the shackles and seizing the blessings of heaven and earth. Those who advance to the level of speed can ascend to high positions at a young age, attracting countless monks to flock to them.
However, the cultivation of literature and Taoism is all supported by the awe-inspiring breath in the chest. It requires polishing knowledge word by word and cultivating a righteous mind bit by bit. There is never a shortcut. How many people study hard all their lives, but they may not be able to touch the threshold of the fairyland. In their later years, they can only bury their bones in the mountains with regrets and may not even be able to pass on what they have learned.
As time goes by, fewer and fewer people are willing to settle down and follow the literary path, and the literary path gradually declines, becoming a heretic in the eyes of the world. Now Xuanyuan College has opened a liberal arts school and held a poetry competition, providing a stage for the liberal arts monks around the world to show off. Now Dean Ji Feixue has also provided a place for cultivation and resources for the liberal arts monks, which has made countless liberal arts scholars even more grateful from the bottom of their hearts.
Today, Xuanyuan Academy has given all the literary monks a way out, a place to stay for everyone who persists to the end, and the opportunity to continue practicing and pass on what they have learned.
Looking at the old man kneeling on the ground with tears streaming down his face, Wen on the stage clenched the Qianqiu Wenxin pen in his hand, his knuckles turning slightly white. Ji Yuntian's words "The rise and fall of literature depends on you and me" repeatedly rang in his ears, and the warm and awe-inspiring energy in his chest kept surging, almost breaking through his chest.
As the dust of this competition settled, a trend of writing poems and essays on Taoism suddenly spread in the world of Cangtian. Many monks who originally only focused on practicing martial arts also began to try to sit down, read and write, and explore the path of literature.
